versions.content: If a BswCalledEntity implementing a server operation is mapped to an OsTask , and the RteBswServerNumberOfRequestProcessing of the related RteBswEventToTaskMapping is not configured, the RTE shall dequeue all pending requests and process them within a single OsTask execution.

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00019, SRS_Rte_00049 If a BswCalledEntity implementing a server operation is mapped to an OsTask , and the RteBswServerNumberOfRequestProcessing of the related RteBsw- EventToTaskMapping is not configured, the RTE shall dequeue all pending requests and process them within a single OsTask execution.
